slides.title: Soft Skills Win Cyber Interviews
slides.subtitle: Nobody prepares for the part that actually matters

bullets: Explain a threat to a non-technical exec
Walk through your process under pressure
Show you can write a clear incident report
Technical knowledge is assumed - clarity wins

caption: Everyone grinds the technical prep. But the question that trips most cyber candidates? 'Explain this risk to a board member.' Soft skills are the real filter nobody talks about. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #infosec #cypherjobs #jobsearch
